case_classification.short_description: Small DCF (no forecasting, estimates given) - deriving the assumptions from a large sheet

ai_time_estimate_reasoning: This task contains several complex, non-standard DCF requirements that require careful implementation and verification. Specifically, the modeler must program a statistical filter for the tax rate (excluding negative rates and those outside two population standard deviations), derive CapEx indirectly from reconstructive balance sheet math, calculate a custom time-weighted average FCFF for the terminal value, implement mid-year discounting, perform a day-count valuation date transition, and build both a target WACC and a circular, iteratively-solved WACC model. Even for an expert, setting up these custom formulas, handling the iterative reference loop, and validating the 26 final answers across two WACC scenarios will take around 80 minutes.
